about_the_game:
Part screensaver, part sleep aid, Daydreams provides an ever-changing, procedural vignette to adorn your computer screen or stream to your television.

Features:

Choose from 12 different scenes with more being added all the time
Choose from 6 different radio stations or add your own

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or compatible 64-bit distro
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stereo audio output required for best experience. PulseAudio or PipeWire recommended for audio.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1+ compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stereo audio output required for best experience. PulseAudio or PipeWire recommended for audio.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Additional Notes: Stereo audio output required for best experience. Universal build supports Intel and Apple Silicon.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon or Intel Iris Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stereo audio output required for best experience. Universal build supports Intel and Apple Silicon.

  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
